title.zh: 摩根大通、高盛削减对Volta约50亿美元AI贷款敞口，仅承销其中13亿美元
title.en: 摩根大通、高盛削减对Volta约50亿美元AI贷款敞口，仅承销其中13亿美元

current_state.zh: JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs are leading a roughly $5 billion loan sale for AI cloud startup Volta Infrastructure Holdings but are underwriting only $1.3 billion of it, leaving about $3.7 billion in chip-related debt ununderwritten to limit their exposure amid investor demands for higher returns on risky AI debt.
